mapper.update: INSERT INTO company (corporate_number, name, kana, name_en, postal_code, location, process, aggregated_year, status, close_date, close_cause, kind, representative_name, capital_stock, employee_number, company_size_male, company_size_female, business_summary, company_url, founding_year, date_of_establishment, qualification_grade, inserted_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{corporateNumber}, #{name}, #{kana}, #{nameEn}, #{postalCode}, #{location}, #{process}, #{aggregatedYear}, #{status}, #{closeDate}, #{closeCause}, #{kind}, #{representativeName}, #{capitalStock}, #{employeeNumber}, #{companySizeMale}, #{companySizeFemale}, #{businessSummary}, #{companyUrl}, #{foundingYear}, #{dateOfEstablishment}, #{qualificationGrade}, NOW(), NULL) ON CONFLICT (corporate_number) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, kana = EXCLUDED.kana, name_en = EXCLUDED.name_en, postal_code = EXCLUDED.postal_code, location = EXCLUDED.location, process = EXCLUDED.process, aggregated_year = EXCLUDED.aggregated_year, status = EXCLUDED.status, close_date = EXCLUDED.close_date, close_cause = EXCLUDED.close_cause, kind = EXCLUDED.kind, representative_name = EXCLUDED.representative_name, capital_stock = EXCLUDED.capital_stock, employee_number = EXCLUDED.employee_number, company_size_male = EXCLUDED.company_size_male, company_size_female = EXCLUDED.company_size_female, business_summary = EXCLUDED.business_summary, company_url = EXCLUDED.company_url, founding_year = EXCLUDED.founding_year, date_of_establishment = EXCLUDED.date_of_establishment, qualification_grade = EXCLUDED.qualification_grade, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT corporate_number as corporateNumber, name, kana, name_en as nameEn, postal_code as postalCode, location, process, aggregated_year as aggregatedYear, status, close_date as closeDate, close_cause as closeCause, kind, representative_name as representativeName, capital_stock as capitalStock, employee_number as employeeNumber, company_size_male as companySizeMale, company_size_female as companySizeFemale, business_summary as businessSummary, company_url as companyUrl, founding_year as foundingYear, date_of_establishment as dateOfEstablishment, qualification_grade as qualificationGrade FROM company WHERE corporate_number = #{corporateNumber}
